attributes.name: Title
attributes.value: Transcriptional profiling by array of human head and neck squamous cell carcinoma to study the correlation between galectin-1 upregulation and the presence of SMA positive cancer-associated fibroblasts

attributes.name: Title
attributes.value: Transcriptional profiling by array of human head and neck squamous cell carcinoma to study the correlation between galectin-1 upregulation and the presence of SMA positive cancer-associated fibroblasts

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: In this study, we set the presence of smooth muscle actin (SMA)-positive cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) in relation to galectin-1 and its in vivo competitor (galectin-3). In squamous cell carcinomas of head and neck, upregulation of galectin-1 presence is highly significantly correlated to presence of smooth muscle actin-positive cancer-associated fibroblasts in the tumor. In order to pinpoint correlations on the molecular level, we applied microarray analyses to the transcription profiles of the corresponding tumors. Significant correlations of several transcripts were detected with the protein level of galectin-1 in the cancer-associated fibroblasts.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: The specimen were obtained from patients suffering from HNSCC after their informed consent in full agreement with the local ethical committee based on the Declaration of Helsinki. Samples from SSC (tumour) and normal epithelium (non-neoplastic epithelium, normal) were collected from each patient. The tissue was protected by RNA-Later (Ambion Inc., Austin, TX, USA), deeply frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at -85C to prevent activity of endogenous RNases. Cryocut sections were washed and rehydrated by phosphate-buffered saline and tested for presence of galectin-1 positive cancer-associated fibroblasts (SMA_Positive_CAF). Frozen sections (Cryocut-E, Reichert-Jung, Vienna, Austria) were used for RNA isolation.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Total RNA was isolated from the cryostat sections using RNeasy Micro Kit (Qiagen) and checked for integrity (RIN).

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: 150 ng of RNA was amplified and labelled using Illumina TotalPrep RNA Amplification Kit (Ambion, Austin, USA) according to the manufacturer's protocol.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: 1.5 microgram of cRNA per hybridisation was hybridised on Illumina HumanWG-6 v3 Expression BeadChip (Illumina, USA) according to the manufacturer's protocol (in Illumina Hybridization Oven).

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Arrays were scanned using Illumina BeadArray Reader (part of Illumina BeadStation 500), according to the manufacturer's protocol.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Summarisation of the calls in GenomeStudio version 1.9.0.24624. No normalisation, no background correction.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Summarisation of the calls in GenomeStudio version 1.9.0.24624. Background corrected, quantile normalised.
